Definitions, derivations, notes, and long tables start folded.

Chapter 4A gallery of programs

The first eight are the toy's own programs; the rest are small ideas to copy and change. Each button opens the toy with that program; then tap it to play t. While the toy is being tried out, it is on the shelf only when Splashery is opened with ?labs=1, but these links always open it.

Sphere

A sphere from two angles, u around and v from pole to pole, spinning with u + t. Six stripes from floor(6u/(2pi)). 

x = sin(v)cos(u + t)
y = cos(v)
z = sin(v)sin(u + t)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. pi
hue = floor(6u/(2pi))/6 + 0.04
size = 0.035
count = 7000
Open it in the toy

Torus

A tube around a ring. v + t rolls the tube around itself, so it turns inside out as you watch. 

x = (2 + cos(v + t))cos(u)
y = sin(v + t)
z = (2 + cos(v + t))sin(u)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. 2pi
hue = v/(2pi)
size = 0.09
count = 6000
Open it in the toy

Möbius strip

A band with a half twist: cos(u/2) turns the band over once as u goes around. The colors flow along it. 

x = (1 + v cos((u + t)/2))cos(u + t)
y = v sin((u + t)/2)
z = (1 + v cos((u + t)/2))sin(u + t)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = -0.4 .. 0.4
hue = u/(2pi)
size = 0.035
count = 4000
Open it in the toy

Seashell

A tube that grows by exp(0.1u) as it winds three times around, turning with u + t. Its splats grow too. 

x = exp(0.1u)cos(u + t)(1.2 + cos v)
y = exp(0.1u)(sin(v) - 2.4) + 3
z = exp(0.1u)sin(u + t)(1.2 + cos v)
u = 0 .. 6pi
v = 0 .. 2pi
hue = 0.02 + 0.1u/(6pi) + 0.03cos(4u)
size = 0.14exp(0.1u)
count = 10000
Open it in the toy

Trefoil knot

The simplest real knot, a curve in u alone, turned about the vertical by the rotation formulas in t. 

x = (sin(u) + 2sin(2u))cos(t) - sin(3u)sin(t)
y = cos(u) - 2cos(2u)
z = -(sin(u) + 2sin(2u))sin(t) - sin(3u)cos(t)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. 1
hue = u/(2pi)
size = 0.16
count = 2500
Open it in the toy

Wave

A flat sheet in u and v with ripples running out from the middle: sin(distance − t).

y = 0.45sin(2sqrt(u^2 + v^2) - t)
z = v
u = -3 .. 3
v = -3 .. 3
hue = 0.58 - 0.07sin(2sqrt(u^2 + v^2) - t)
size = 0.07
count = 6000
Open it in the toy

Spiral galaxy

Two arms from floor(v) (0 or 1, half a turn apart), scattered at random, turning once. Colors from r, g, and b. 

x = u^1.5 cos(pi floor(v) + 5u + 1.2(v - floor(v)) - t)
y = 0.06(1 - u)sin(91v + 37u)
z = u^1.5 sin(pi floor(v) + 5u + 1.2(v - floor(v)) - t)
u = 0.02 .. 1
v = 0 .. 2
r = 0.55 + 0.45(1 - u)^2
g = 0.62 + 0.33(1 - u)^2
b = 1 - 0.45(1 - u)^3
size = 0.006 + 0.012(1 - u)^2
count = 10000
spread = random
Open it in the toy

Klein bottle (figure eight)

The figure-eight Klein bottle: a figure-eight tube around a ring, with a half twist, so it has no inside or outside.

y = sin(u/2)sin(v + t) + cos(u/2)sin(2v + 2t)
z = (2 + cos(u/2)sin(v + t) - sin(u/2)sin(2v + 2t))sin(u)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. 2pi
hue = v/(2pi)
size = 0.13
count = 8000
Open it in the toy

Sixty more programs

A second gallery, in six groups of ten, written and then checked by hand: each program reads, builds, and looks like its title. A few are honest look-alikes or samples of a named system, and say so; none is a full solution of the system it names. Each card has the picture, one line about the shape, the program (folded), and a Run it link that opens the Splat equation toy with that program, in a new tab. That toy is a labs toy: it is not on the ordinary shelf, but a direct link like these opens it even with labs off, and its sharper kernel setting needs labs turned on. Every program fits the toy's own limits: 12 fields, 240 characters each (these programs are all under 120, so they would fit the old limit too), and at most 10,000 points.

Spun sphere

A sphere turns once around its vertical axis, and its hue runs around the axis (by longitude), so the colors turn with it.

Show the program

y = cos(v)
z = sin(v)sin(u+t)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. pi
hue = u/(2pi)
size = 0.04
count = 6000
